$comment: 'known' = sensitive source files ALREADY tracked under public/ when the guard
was introduced. They are reported on every run but do not fail the build, so
CI stays green while relocation is scheduled. Anything NOT listed fails
immediately. This is a to-do list, not a permanent exemption.
'allowed' = files under public/ in a blocked format that are GENUINE public
downloads and should never be flagged. Each needs a justification here.
XPA-1 does not delete or move anything (the phase brief forbids it); the
relocation is performed and tested in a dedicated change.

public/images/Certificate of Completion..what: Editable PowerPoint source for the completion certificate design.
public/images/Certificate of Completion..status: LIVE in production — verified HTTP 200 at /images/Certificate%20of%20Completion.pptx
public/images/Certificate of Completion..why_not_a_learner_download: Zero references in app/, components/ or lib/ (XPA-0 audit). No UI links to it; it is design source material that followed the image assets into public/.
public/images/Certificate of Completion..risk: An editable certificate template is publicly downloadable, which lowers the effort to forge a convincing certificate. Verification is by certificate number against the public verify page, so this is a credibility risk rather than an authentication bypass.
public/images/Certificate of Completion..action: Relocate to docs/source-material/xp-client-academy/ and untrack from public/ in a dedicated change with production verification.
